summary: Opened sales order S00021 (sale.order id=21) and clicked the status-bar "Cancel" button, which opened the "Cancel Sales Order" dialog ("Are you sure you want to cancel this order?" with buttons Send and cancel / Cancel / Discard). Its action_cancel button had to be activated with Enter because pointer clicks on the dialog were being intercepted by a leftover inert overlay; that committed the cancellation. (a) The breadcrumb/level-1 heading still reads "S00021" (final URL unchanged: /web#cids=1&menu_id=194&action=316&model=sale.order&view_type=form&id=21). (b) The status bar now shows "Cancelled" as the checked stage — read back as aria-checked=true on the "Cancelled" arrow button, with Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation all false and disabled. (c) The Cancel button is gone: the status-bar buttons are now only "Preview" and "Set to Quotation", and two system notifications appear in the chatter. Not verified: the browser tab title in this exact state (I did not re-read it directly).
